name: weapons/warden_shot_punch
prompt:
summary: A static close-up of the muzzle brake of a long black sniper rifle at an outdoor range.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A static close-up of the muzzle brake of a long black sniper rifle at an outdoor range. It fires exactly one round: a big flash and a puff of dust, then it is still. The camera is static and locked-off.

overall_soundscape: Foley recording, close microphone: one single very loud punchy sniper rifle shot, a hard explosive bang with a tight low boom and a bright crack, then a short echo that dies away within one and a half seconds, then silence. Nothing else is heard: no music, no speech, no voices.
